L'article se concentre sur les préparatifs logistiques et la transparence, sans mentionner comment les communautés noires et afro-colombiennes sont affectées par les processus électoraux.
title: Ministerio de Hacienda ya le asignó los recursos a la Registraduría para la segunda vuelta presidencial

narrative_analysis: Zimbabwe and the Caribbean candidate appear in the voting tally as numbers, their communities reduced to electoral results without discussion of their specific challenges.
cui_bono: Permanent UN Security Council members who resist reform.
summary: Portugal and Austria won seats on the UN Security Council, defeating Germany, while Kyrgyzstan defeated the Philippines. Zimbabwe and Trinidad and Tobago were elected unopposed, highlighting the ongoing lack of reform in the council's structure.
title_en: Portugal and Austria defeat Germany for seats on UN Security Council
title_es: Portugal y Austria derrotan a Alemania por los escaños en el Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU
title_pt: Portugal e Áustria derrotam a Alemanha por assentos no Conselho de Segurança da ONU
title_fr: Le Portugal et l'Autriche battent l'Allemagne pour les sièges au Conseil de sécurité de l'ONU
summary_es: Portugal y Austria ganaron escaños en el Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU, derrotando a Alemania, mientras que Kirguistán derrotó a Filipinas. Zimbabue y Trinidad y Tobago fueron elegidos sin oposición, destacando la falta de reforma en la estructura del consejo.
summary_pt: Portugal e Áustria conquistaram assentos no Conselho de Segurança da ONU, derrotando a Alemanha, enquanto o Quirguistão derrotou as Filipinas. Zimbábue e Trinidad e Tobago foram eleitos sem oposição, destacando a falta de reforma na estrutura do conselho.
summary_fr: Le Portugal et l'Autriche ont remporté des sièges au Conseil de sécurité de l'ONU, battant l'Allemagne, tandis que le Kirghizistan a battu les Philippines. Le Zimbabwe et Trinité-et-Tobago ont été élus sans opposition, soulignant le manque de réforme de la structure du conseil.
title: Portugal and Austria defeat Germany for seats on UN Security CouncilKyrgyzstan beat the Philippines by a vote of 143-49 to join the council for the first time.

narrative_analysis: Kenyans are depicted as a population whose land and health security are subordinated to American needs, echoing colonial extraction.
cui_bono: The United States government
summary: Kenya's health minister insists the US-funded Ebola quarantine center at Laikipia Air Base will open despite protests and court orders. Two people were killed in demonstrations against the facility, which critics see as a colonial-era imposition.
title_en: Kenya health minister says US Ebola quarantine centre will proceed amid protests
title_es: Ministro de Salud de Kenia dice que el centro de cuarentena contra el ébola de EE.UU. continuará pese a protestas
title_pt: Ministro da Saúde do Quênia diz que centro de quarentena contra ebola dos EUA prosseguirá apesar de protestos
title_fr: Le ministre de la Santé du Kenya déclare que le centre de quarantaine contre Ebola des États-Unis se poursuivra malgré les protestations
summary_es: El ministro de Salud de Kenia insiste en que el centro de cuarentena contra el ébola financiado por EE.UU. en la Base Aérea de Laikipia se abrirá pese a las protestas y órdenes judiciales. Dos personas murieron en manifestaciones contra el proyecto, que los críticos ven como una imposición colonial.
summary_pt: O ministro da Saúde do Quênia insiste que o centro de quarentena contra ebola financiado pelos EUA na Base Aérea de Laikipia será aberto apesar de protestas e ordens judiciais. Duas pessoas morreram em manifestações contra o projeto, que críticos veem como uma imposição colonial.
summary_fr: Le ministre de la Santé du Kenya insiste sur le fait que le centre de quarantaine contre Ebola financé par les États-Unis sur la base aérienne de Laikipia ouvrira malgré les protestations et les ordonnances judiciaires. Deux personnes ont été tuées lors de manifestations contre ce projet, que les critiques considèrent comme une imposition coloniale.
title: Kenya health minister says US Ebola quarantine centre will proceed amid protests

narrative_analysis: Black communities are completely absent from this story, which focuses solely on technical and economic aspects of the C909 jet in Xinjiang.
cui_bono: Comac and Chinese state-owned airlines
summary: The article describes how China's domestically made C909 regional jet has found success in Xinjiang, with 30 aircraft serving over 120 routes. It highlights the jet's cost efficiency compared to Boeing 737s, focusing on operational metrics and regional deployment.
title_en: Why China’s C909 jet is rapidly being deployed in Xinjiang
title_es: Por qué el avión C909 de China se está desplegando rápidamente en Xinjiang
title_pt: Por que o jato C909 da China está sendo implantado rapidamente em Xinjiang
title_fr: Pourquoi l'avion C909 de la Chine est déployé rapidement au Xinjiang
summary_es: El artículo describe cómo el avión regional C909, fabricado en China, ha tenido éxito en Xinjiang, con 30 aeronaves operando más de 120 rutas. Destaca su eficiencia en costos en comparación con los Boeing 737, centrándose en métricas operativas y despliegue regional.
summary_pt: O artigo descreve como o jato regional C909, fabricado na China, obteve sucesso em Xinjiang, com 30 aeronaves operando mais de 120 rotas. Destaca sua eficiência de custos em comparação com os Boeing 737, focando em métricas operacionais e implantação regional.
summary_fr: L'article décrit comment l'avion régional C909, fabriqué en Chine, a réussi au Xinjiang, avec 30 appareils desservant plus de 120 routes. Il souligne son efficacité en termes de coûts par rapport aux Boeing 737, en se concentrant sur des métriques opérationnelles et un déploiement régional.
title: Why China’s C909 jet is rapidly being deployed in Xinjiang

narrative_analysis: Kenyans are shown as actively protesting and legally challenging a US quarantine facility, which highlights a community resisting perceived exploitation and health risks imposed by a foreign power.
cui_bono: United States government avoids domestic health risks and costs.
summary: A Kenyan court extended a block on a US Ebola quarantine center in Nanyuki after protests left two dead. Kenyans accuse the US of offloading health risks, and the court ordered disclosure of the agreement with Washington.
title_en: Protests over US Ebola centre in Kenya kill 2
title_es: Protestas por el centro estadounidense contra el ébola en Kenia dejan 2 muertos
title_pt: Protestos contra centro de ebola dos EUA no Quênia matam 2
title_fr: Des manifestations contre un centre américain contre Ebola au Kenya font 2 morts
summary_es: Un tribunal keniano extendió por tres semanas el bloqueo a un centro de cuarentena contra el ébola de EE.UU. en Nanyuki, tras protestas que dejaron dos muertos. Los kenianos acusan a EE.UU. de transferir riesgos de salud, y el tribunal ordenó revelar el acuerdo con Washington.
summary_pt: Um tribunal queniano prorrogou por três semanas o bloqueio a um centro de quarentena de ebola dos EUA em Nanyuki, após protestos que deixaram dois mortos. Quenianos acusam os EUA de transferir riscos de saúde, e o tribunal ordenou divulgar o acordo com Washington.
summary_fr: Un tribunal kenyan a prolongé de trois semaines le blocage d'un centre de quarantaine contre Ebola des États-Unis à Nanyuki, après des manifestations ayant fait deux morts. Les Kenyans accusent les États-Unis de transférer des risques sanitaires, et le tribunal a ordonné la divulgation de l'accord avec Washington.
title: Protests over US Ebola centre in Kenya kill 2A Kenyan court blocked the proposed US Ebola quarantine centre for another three weeks.

narrative_analysis: The report reduces Black communities to a count of untraced contacts and struggling health systems, implying their lives are expendable in the global health order.
cui_bono: Pharmaceutical companies and international health organizations gain from outbreak response contracts.
summary: The WHO chief visits DR Congo as an aid group warns that four out of five Ebola contacts have gone untraced, suggesting the outbreak is larger than reported. The story highlights systemic failures in health infrastructure and community trust.
title_en: WHO chief ends DR Congo visit as group warns Ebola likely spread undetected
title_es: El jefe de la OMS concluye visita a RDC mientras grupo advierte que el ébola probablemente se ha propagado sin detectar
title_pt: Chefe da OMS encerra visita à RD Congo enquanto grupo alerta que Ebola provavelmente se espalhou sem detecção
title_fr: Le chef de l'OMS termine sa visite en RDC alors qu'un groupe prévient que le virus Ebola s'est probablement propagé sans être détecté
summary_es: El jefe de la OMS visita la RDC mientras una agencia advierte que cuatro de cada cinco contactos del ébola no han sido rastreados, lo que sugiere que el brote es mayor de lo reportado. La historia destaca fallos sistémicos en la infraestructura sanitaria y la confianza comunitaria.
summary_pt: O chefe da OMS visita a RD Congo enquanto uma agência alerta que quatro em cada cinco contatos do Ebola não foram rastreados, sugerindo que o surto é maior do que o relatado. A história destaca falhas sistêmicas na infraestrutura de saúde e na confiança comunitária.
summary_fr: Le chef de l'OMS se rend en RDC alors qu'une agence prévient que quatre contacts sur cinq du virus Ebola n'ont pas été retrouvés, suggérant que l'épidémie est plus importante que signalé. L'article met en lumière des défaillances systémiques dans les infrastructures de santé et la confiance des communautés.
title: WHO chief ends DR Congo visit as group warns Ebola likely spread undetectedTedros meets President Tshisekedi amid warnings that four out of five virus contacts have gone untraced.

narrative_analysis: Black Africans are treated as bureaucratic obstacles to be managed, their mobility curtailed by distant policy decisions that ignore the continent's diverse needs.
cui_bono: The US State Department and Trump administration benefit.
summary: The US State Department plans to reduce visa-processing embassies in Africa from nearly 50 to 20, forcing applicants to travel longer distances. The move is part of broader efforts to limit immigration and overstays, and it disproportionately affects African travelers.
title_en: US to slash number of embassies in Africa that process visas
title_es: EE.UU. reducirá drásticamente el número de embajadas en África que tramitan visados
title_pt: EUA reduzirão drasticamente o número de embaixadas na África que processam vistos
title_fr: Les États-Unis vont réduire drastiquement le nombre d'ambassades en Afrique traitant les visas
summary_es: El Departamento de Estado planea reducir las embajadas que tramitan visados en África de casi 50 a 20, obligando a los solicitantes a viajar más lejos. La medida busca limitar la inmigración y afecta desproporcionadamente a los viajeros africanos.
summary_pt: O Departamento de Estado planeja reduzir as embaixadas que processam vistos na África de quase 50 para 20, forçando os solicitantes a viajar mais longe. A medida visa limitar a imigração e afeta desproporcionalmente os viajantes africanos.
summary_fr: Le Département d'État prévoit de réduire les ambassades traitant les visas en Afrique de près de 50 à 20, obligeant les demandeurs à voyager plus loin. Cette mesure vise à limiter l'immigration et affecte de manière disproportionnée les voyageurs africains.
title: US to slash number of embassies in Africa that process visasUS State Department consolidation will force applicants across the continent to travel to 20 central hubs.

narrative_analysis: Kenyan youth appear as active resisters against a foreign quarantine plan, yet the coverage subtly questions their motives rather than the structural inequities driving it.
cui_bono: United States government and its disaster response infrastructure.
summary: Hundreds of Kenyan youths protested the establishment of an Ebola quarantine center for US citizens at Laikipia Air Base. Health Minister Aden Duale claimed the facility was for everyone, not exclusively Americans, but the High Court had suspended its operation pending a legal challenge.
title_en: Young Kenyans protest Ebola quarantine centre for US citizens
title_es: Jóvenes kenianos protestan por centro de cuarentena contra el ébola para ciudadanos estadounidenses
title_pt: Jovens quenianos protestam contra centro de quarentena de Ebola para cidadãos dos EUA
title_fr: Des jeunes Kényans protestent contre un centre de quarantaine contre Ebola pour les citoyens américains
summary_es: Cientos de jóvenes kenianos protestaron contra el establecimiento de un centro de cuarentena contra el ébola para ciudadanos estadounidenses en la base aérea de Laikipia. El ministro de Salud afirmó que la instalación era para todos, pero el tribunal suspendió su operación.
summary_pt: Centenas de jovens quenianos protestaram contra a criação de um centro de quarentena de Ebola para cidadãos dos EUA na base aérea de Laikipia. O ministro da Saúde afirmou que a instalação era para todos, mas o tribunal suspendeu sua operação.
summary_fr: Des centaines de jeunes Kényans ont protesté contre la création d’un centre de quarantaine contre Ebola pour les citoyens américains à la base aérienne de Laikipia. Le ministre de la Santé a déclaré que l’installation était pour tous, mais le tribunal a suspendu son fonctionnement.
title: Young Kenyans protest Ebola quarantine centre for US citizensHealth Minister Aden Duale has said the quarantine centre was for ‘everyone’ and not exclusively for US nationals.

narrative_analysis: Nigerian voters emerge as strategic agents navigating elite fragmentation, yet the story normalizes their exclusion from genuine economic power through colonial-era patronage systems.
cui_bono: Incumbent Bola Tinubu and established political elites.
summary: Nigeria's opposition is divided as Peter Obi and Atiku Abubakar run separately, weakening their challenge to incumbent President Bola Tinubu. Despite economic hardship and insurgency, Tinubu is favored to win a second term in January's election.
title_en: Nigeria’s opposition divided, incumbent Tinubu eyes second term
title_es: La oposición de Nigeria dividida, el presidente Tinubu busca un segundo mandato
title_pt: Oposição da Nigéria dividida, presidente Tinubu busca segundo mandato
title_fr: L'opposition nigériane divisée, le président Tinubu vise un second mandat
summary_es: La oposición de Nigeria está dividida, ya que Peter Obi y Atiku Abubakar se postulan por separado, debilitando su desafío al presidente Bola Tinubu. A pesar de las dificultades económicas y la insurgencia, Tinubu es favorito para ganar un segundo mandato en enero.
summary_pt: A oposição da Nigéria está dividida, com Peter Obi e Atiku Abubakar concorrendo separadamente, enfraquecendo seu desafio ao presidente Bola Tinubu. Apesar das dificuldades econômicas e da insurgência, Tinubu é favorito para vencer um segundo mandato em janeiro.
summary_fr: L'opposition nigériane est divisée, Peter Obi et Atiku Abubakar se présentant séparément, affaiblissant leur défi au président Bola Tinubu. Malgré les difficultés économiques et l'insurrection, Tinubu est favori pour remporter un second mandat en janvier.
title: Nigeria’s opposition divided, incumbent Tinubu eyes second termDespite economic pains and an Islamist insurgency, Nigerian President Bola Tinubu is viewed as the front runner in January’s elections.

narrative_analysis: Black communities are absent from this story, which centers on geopolitical maneuvering between the UK and China without reference to racial dynamics.
cui_bono: British and Chinese governments benefit from restored diplomatic and trade relations.
summary: UK Foreign Secretary David Lammy (referred to as 'Cooper' in the text from Reuters) will visit China for talks covering military engagement, the Strait of Hormuz, the Russia-Ukraine war, and the Ebola outbreak in Africa. The visit aims to strengthen UK-China ties and deepen strategic partnership.
title_en: In sign of easing UK-China ties, British Foreign Secretary set for 3-day visit
title_es: Como señal de distensión en las relaciones Reino Unido-China, el secretario de Relaciones Exteriores británico realizará una visita de 3 días
title_pt: Como sinal de alívio nas relações Reino Unido-China, secretário de Relações Exteriores britânico fará visita de 3 dias
title_fr: Signe d'un apaisement des relations Royaume-Uni-Chine, le secrétaire d'État britannique aux Affaires étrangères prévoit une visite de 3 jours
summary_es: El secretario de Relaciones Exteriores del Reino Unido, David Lammy, visitará China para conversaciones sobre compromiso militar, el Estrecho de Ormuz, la guerra Rusia-Ucrania y el brote de ébola en África. La visita busca fortalecer los lazos bilaterales y profundizar la asociación estratégica.
summary_pt: O secretário de Relações Exteriores do Reino Unido, David Lammy, visitará a China para conversas sobre engajamento militar, o Estreito de Ormuz, a guerra Rússia-Ucrânia e o surto de Ebola na África. A visita visa fortalecer os laços bilaterais e aprofundar a parceria estratégica.
summary_fr: Le secrétaire d'État britannique aux Affaires étrangères, David Lammy, se rendra en Chine pour des discussions sur l'engagement militaire, le détroit d'Ormuz, la guerre Russie-Ukraine et l'épidémie d'Ebola en Afrique. Cette visite vise à renforcer les liens bilatéraux et à approfondir le partenariat stratégique.
title: In sign of easing UK-China ties, British Foreign Secretary set for 3-day visitAnnouncement comes days after delegations from both countries sat down at Shangri-La Dialogue to discuss concrete military engagement.

narrative_analysis: Black African lives appear mainly as numbers—cases and funding gaps—while the systemic neglect of healthcare infrastructure remains unspoken.
cui_bono: Global pharmaceutical corporations benefit from underfunded public health systems.
summary: Former CDC head Tom Frieden warns that the world is failing the Ebola outbreak stress test, with underfunding and partial border closures hampering response. The story focuses on logistical and financial shortcomings without addressing colonial or economic roots of Africa's vulnerability.
title_en: Ebola shows world unprepared for next pandemic, ex-US CDC head says
title_es: El ébola demuestra que el mundo no está preparado para la próxima pandemia, dice exdirector de los CDC de EE.UU.
title_pt: Ébola mostra que mundo não está preparado para próxima pandemia, diz ex-diretor do CDC dos EUA
title_fr: L'Ebola montre que le monde n'est pas préparé à la prochaine pandémie, selon l'ancien directeur du CDC américain
summary_es: El exdirector de los CDC, Tom Frieden, advierte que el mundo está fallando en la prueba de estrés del brote de ébola, con falta de financiación y cierres fronterizos parciales que obstaculizan la respuesta. La historia se centra en deficiencias logísticas y financieras sin abordar raíces coloniales o económicas de la vulnerabilidad de África.
summary_pt: O ex-diretor do CDC Tom Frieden alerta que o mundo está falhando no teste de estresse do surto de ébola, com subfinanciamento e fechamentos parciais de fronteiras dificultando a resposta. A história foca em deficiências logísticas e financeiras sem abordar as raízes coloniais ou econômicas da vulnerabilidade da África.
summary_fr: L'ancien directeur du CDC Tom Frieden prévient que le monde échoue au test de stress de l'épidémie d'Ebola, avec un sous-financement et des fermetures partielles de frontières entravant la réponse. L'histoire se concentre sur les lacunes logistiques et financières sans aborder les racines coloniales ou économiques de la vulnérabilité de l'Afrique.
title: Ebola shows world unprepared for next pandemic, ex-US CDC head saysTom Frieden called the latest outbreak of the deadly disease a ‘stress test’ that the world is failing so far.

narrative_analysis: Black communities appear as targets of rising violence and systemic neglect, yet Amnesty International frames them as demanding accountability and structural reform.
cui_bono: The Northern Ireland Executive benefits by avoiding binding commitments and funding obligations.
summary: Amnesty International UK criticizes Northern Ireland's draft race relations framework as weak and insufficient to address rising racist violence. The group argues the plan focuses on inter-community tensions rather than structural inequality and lacks clear targets, funding, and accountability.
title_en: Northern Ireland race relations plan fails to tackle rising racist violence says Amnesty
title_es: Plan de relaciones raciales de Irlanda del Norte no logra abordar la creciente violencia racista, según Amnistía
title_pt: Plano de relações raciais da Irlanda do Norte falha em combater a violência racista crescente, diz Anistia
title_fr: Le plan des relations raciales en Irlande du Nord ne parvient pas à lutter contre la montée de la violence raciste, selon Amnesty
summary_es: Amnistía Internacional Reino Unido critica el borrador del marco de relaciones raciales de Irlanda del Norte por ser débil e insuficiente para abordar la creciente violencia racista. El grupo argumenta que el plan se centra en tensiones entre comunidades en lugar de desigualdad estructural y carece de objetivos claros, financiación y rendición de cuentas.
summary_pt: A Anistia Internacional Reino Unido critica o rascunho do quadro de relações raciais da Irlanda do Norte como fraco e insuficiente para lidar com a crescente violência racista. O grupo argumenta que o plano foca em tensões entre comunidades em vez de desigualdade estrutural e carece de metas claras, financiamento e responsabilização.
summary_fr: Amnesty International Royaume-Uni critique le projet de cadre des relations raciales de l'Irlande du Nord comme étant faible et insuffisant pour faire face à la montée de la violence raciste. Le groupe affirme que le plan se concentre sur les tensions entre communautés plutôt que sur les inégalités structurelles et manque d'objectifs clairs, de financement et de responsabilité.
title: Northern Ireland race relations plan fails to tackle rising racist violence says Amnesty

narrative_analysis: Black women in Malawi appear as victims of preventable harm, forced to improvise with razor blades and buckets, implying systemic neglect.
cui_bono: Private water and sanitation corporations.
summary: WaterAid's campaign reveals stark maternal health inequalities by examining what women pack for childbirth across 13 countries. In Malawi, women must bring their own razor blades and buckets due to lack of clean water and hygiene supplies, while UK mothers pack comfort items.
title_en: What’s in her hospital bag? A global snapshot of maternal health inequality
title_es: ¿Qué hay en su bolsa de hospital? Una instantánea global de la desigualdad en la salud materna
title_pt: O que há na bolsa de maternidade dela? Um retrato global da desigualdade na saúde materna
title_fr: Que contient son sac de maternité ? Un aperçu mondial des inégalités en santé maternelle
summary_es: La campaña de WaterAid revela marcadas desigualdades en la salud materna al examinar lo que las mujeres empacan para el parto en 13 países. En Malawi, las mujeres deben llevar sus propias cuchillas y baldes por falta de agua potable e higiene, mientras que en el Reino Unido las madres empacan artículos de confort.
summary_pt: A campanha da WaterAid revela desigualdades gritantes na saúde materna ao examinar o que as mulheres levam para o parto em 13 países. No Malawi, as mulheres precisam levar lâminas e baldes devido à falta de água potável e itens de higiene, enquanto no Reino Unido as mães levam itens de conforto.
summary_fr: La campagne de WaterAid révèle des inégalités flagrantes en matière de santé maternelle en examinant ce que les femmes emportent pour accoucher dans 13 pays. Au Malawi, les femmes doivent apporter leurs propres lames et seaux par manque d'eau potable et d'hygiène, tandis qu'au Royaume-Uni, les mères emportent des articles de confort.
title: What’s in her hospital bag? A global snapshot of maternal health inequality

narrative_analysis: The forecast reduces Caribbean communities to a statistic in a weather report, erasing the lived reality of their vulnerability.
cui_bono: Insurance and reinsurance companies benefit from predictable, below-normal storm seasons.
summary: The article reports NOAA's forecast of a below-normal 2026 Atlantic hurricane season. It briefly mentions last year's Hurricane Melissa, which devastated Haiti, Jamaica, and Cuba, but does not analyze the disproportionate vulnerability of Black Caribbean nations.
title_en: Forecasters predict below-normal hurricane season across the Atlantic
title_es: Pronosticadores predicen una temporada de huracanes por debajo de lo normal en el Atlántico
title_pt: Previsores preveem temporada de furacões abaixo do normal no Atlântico
title_fr: Les prévisionnistes annoncent une saison des ouragans inférieure à la normale dans l'Atlantique
summary_es: El artículo informa sobre el pronóstico de la NOAA de una temporada de huracanes 2026 por debajo de lo normal en el Atlántico. Menciona brevemente el huracán Melissa del año pasado, que devastó Haití, Jamaica y Cuba, pero no analiza la vulnerabilidad desproporcionada de las naciones caribeñas negras.
summary_pt: O artigo relata a previsão da NOAA de uma temporada de furacões no Atlântico abaixo do normal para 2026. Menciona brevemente o furacão Melissa do ano passado, que devastou Haiti, Jamaica e Cuba, mas não analisa a vulnerabilidade desproporcional das nações negras do Caribe.
summary_fr: L'article rapporte les prévisions de la NOAA d'une saison des ouragans 2026 inférieure à la normale dans l'Atlantique. Il mentionne brièvement l'ouragan Melissa de l'année dernière, qui a dévasté Haïti, la Jamaïque et Cuba, mais n'analyse pas la vulnérabilité disproportionnée des nations noires des Caraïbes.
title: Forecasters predict below-normal hurricane season across the Atlantic

narrative_analysis: The three Black sisters are portrayed as beloved family members whose tragic deaths inspire communal support, yet the lack of context around their circumstances risks erasing structural vulnerabilities.
cui_bono: Unclear.
summary: The family of three Black sisters found dead off Brighton beach thanks the public for raising nearly £45,000. An inquest has opened with no third-party involvement suspected, but the cause of death remains unknown.
title_en: Family of three sisters whose bodies were recovered off Brighton beach thank public for generosity
title_es: Familia de tres hermanas cuyos cuerpos fueron recuperados de la playa de Brighton agradece al público su generosidad
title_pt: Família de três irmãs cujos corpos foram recuperados na praia de Brighton agradece ao público pela generosidade
title_fr: La famille de trois sœurs dont les corps ont été retrouvés sur la plage de Brighton remercie le public pour sa générosité
summary_es: La familia de tres hermanas negras encontradas muertas en la playa de Brighton agradece al público por haber recaudado casi 45.000 libras. Se ha abierto una investigación sin que se sospeche participación de terceros, pero la causa de la muerte sigue siendo desconocida.
summary_pt: A família de três irmãs negras encontradas mortas na praia de Brighton agradece ao público por ter arrecadado quase £45.000. Um inquérito foi aberto sem suspeita de envolvimento de terceiros, mas a causa da morte permanece desconhecida.
summary_fr: La famille de trois sœurs noires retrouvées mortes sur la plage de Brighton remercie le public d'avoir récolté près de 45 000 £. Une enquête a été ouverte sans soupçon d'implication de tiers, mais la cause du décès reste inconnue.
title: Family of three sisters whose bodies were recovered off Brighton beach thank public for generosity

narrative_analysis: Barnes speaks candidly about his diagnosis and recovery, positioning Black men as proactive agents in overcoming stigma and seeking life-saving care.
cui_bono: National health systems benefit from early detection and reduced treatment costs.
summary: Former Liverpool star John Barnes reveals he underwent prostate cancer surgery and urges men, especially Black men, to overcome stigma and get tested. He highlights that prostate cancer is more prevalent in Black men and calls for greater awareness.
title_en: Former Liverpool star John Barnes reveals prostate cancer diagnosis, urges men to seek help
title_es: La ex estrella del Liverpool John Barnes revela diagnóstico de cáncer de próstata y exhorta a los hombres a buscar ayuda
title_pt: Ex-estrela do Liverpool John Barnes revela diagnóstico de câncer de próstata e insta homens a buscarem ajuda
title_fr: L'ancienne star de Liverpool John Barnes révèle un diagnostic de cancer de la prostate et exhorte les hommes à chercher de l'aide
summary_es: El exdelantero del Liverpool John Barnes reveló que se sometió a una cirugía de próstata por cáncer e insta a los hombres, especialmente a los negros, a superar el estigma y hacerse pruebas. Destaca que el cáncer de próstata es más prevalente en hombres negros.
summary_pt: O ex-atacante do Liverpool John Barnes revelou que passou por uma cirurgia de próstata devido a câncer e incentiva homens, especialmente negros, a superar o estigma e fazer exames. Ele destaca que o câncer de próstata é mais prevalente em homens negros.
summary_fr: L'ancien attaquant de Liverpool John Barnes a révélé avoir subi une chirurgie de la prostate pour un cancer et exhorte les hommes, en particulier les Noirs, à surmonter la stigmatisation et à se faire dépister. Il souligne que le cancer de la prostate est plus fréquent chez les hommes noirs.
title: Former Liverpool star John Barnes reveals prostate cancer diagnosis, urges men to seek help

narrative_analysis: These Jamaican football clubs are presented as competitive and ambitious, a portrayal that affirms Black athletic excellence without confronting structural barriers.
cui_bono: Concacaf and regional football organizers benefit from expanded competition.
summary: Jamaican Premier League champions Portmore United and runners-up Cavalier SC will begin their Concacaf Caribbean Cup group-stage in early August. The schedule includes home and away matches across the Caribbean region.
title_en: Portmore and Cavalier to kick off Concacaf schedule in early August
title_es: Portmore y Cavalier iniciarán el calendario de la Concacaf a principios de agosto
title_pt: Portmore e Cavalier iniciarão a programação da Concacaf no início de agosto
title_fr: Portmore et Cavalier débuteront le calendrier de la Concacaf début août
summary_es: Los campeones de la Premier League de Jamaica, Portmore United, y los subcampeones, Cavalier SC, comenzarán su fase de grupos de la Copa Caribeña de la Concacaf a principios de agosto. El calendario incluye partidos de ida y vuelta en toda la región del Caribe.
summary_pt: Os campeões da Premier League da Jamaica, Portmore United, e os vice-campeões, Cavalier SC, começarão a fase de grupos da Copa do Caribe da Concacaf no início de agosto. A programação inclui jogos em casa e fora em toda a região do Caribe.
summary_fr: Les champions de la Premier League jamaïcaine, Portmore United, et les finalistes, Cavalier SC, débuteront leur phase de groupes de la Coupe des Caraïbes de la Concacaf début août. Le calendrier comprend des matchs aller-retour dans toute la région des Caraïbes.
title: Portmore and Cavalier to kick off Concacaf schedule in early August

narrative_analysis: The accused employee is portrayed as a solitary criminal betraying institutional trust, which individualizes wrongdoing and sidesteps systemic accountability in Caribbean public institutions.
cui_bono: The Caribbean Maritime University's management benefits by deflecting scrutiny from internal controls.
summary: A CMU employee, Kevan Anthony Panton, was arrested for allegedly embezzling over JMD $1 million in student funds. The Financial Investigations Division emphasized the need for stronger internal controls at the university.
title_en: CMU employee charged over alleged misappropriation of student funds
title_es: Empleado de la CMU acusado por presunta malversación de fondos estudiantiles
title_pt: Funcionário da CMU acusado por suposto desvio de fundos estudantis
title_fr: Employé de la CMU inculpé pour détournement présumé de fonds étudiants
summary_es: Un empleado de la CMU, Kevan Anthony Panton, fue arrestado por presuntamente malversar más de JMD $1 millón en fondos estudiantiles. La División de Investigaciones Financieras enfatizó la necesidad de controles internos más fuertes en la universidad.
summary_pt: Um funcionário da CMU, Kevan Anthony Panton, foi preso por supostamente desviar mais de JMD $1 milhão em fundos estudantis. A Divisão de Investigações Financeiras enfatizou a necessidade de controles internos mais fortes na universidade.
summary_fr: Un employé de la CMU, Kevan Anthony Panton, a été arrêté pour avoir prétendument détourné plus d'un million de JMD de fonds étudiants. La Division des enquêtes financières a souligné la nécessité de renforcer les contrôles internes à l'université.
title: CMU employee charged over alleged misappropriation of student funds

narrative_analysis: The story portrays Black Jamaicans and diaspora members as empowered investors and partners in national development, casting them as active agents of economic progress.
cui_bono: Treasure Bay Estates and its co-principals benefit most.
summary: Treasure Bay Estates participated as the platinum sponsor of THROP-X 2026, a real estate investment conference in Jamaica. The event aimed to connect diaspora investors with local opportunities, emphasizing wealth creation and national development.
title_en: Treasure Bay Estates highlights investment opportunities at THROP-X 2026
title_es: Treasure Bay Estates destaca oportunidades de inversión en THROP-X 2026
title_pt: Treasure Bay Estates destaca oportunidades de investimento na THROP-X 2026
title_fr: Treasure Bay Estates met en avant les opportunités d'investissement à THROP-X 2026
summary_es: Treasure Bay Estates participó como patrocinador platino de THROP-X 2026, una conferencia de inversión inmobiliaria en Jamaica. El evento buscó conectar a inversores de la diáspora con oportunidades locales, enfatizando la creación de riqueza y el desarrollo nacional.
summary_pt: A Treasure Bay Estates participou como patrocinadora platina da THROP-X 2026, uma conferência de investimento imobiliário na Jamaica. O evento visou conectar investidores da diáspora a oportunidades locais, enfatizando a criação de riqueza e o desenvolvimento nacional.
summary_fr: Treasure Bay Estates a participé en tant que sponsor platine de THROP-X 2026, une conférence sur l'investissement immobilier en Jamaïque. L'événement visait à connecter les investisseurs de la diaspora aux opportunités locales, en mettant l'accent sur la création de richesse et le développement national.
title: Treasure Bay Estates highlights investment opportunities at THROP-X 2026

narrative_analysis: Jamaicans are portrayed as proactive agents and stakeholders in adapting to global economic shifts, with policy focused on improving their daily lives and productivity.
cui_bono: The Jamaican government and private sector employers.
summary: Jamaica's parliamentary committee will review flexible work options to address rising fuel prices and global economic uncertainty. The initiative aims to enhance productivity, reduce costs, and improve work-life balance for workers.
title_en: Parliamentary committee to review flexible work options amid rising fuel prices
title_es: Comité parlamentario revisará opciones de trabajo flexible en medio del aumento de los precios del combustible
title_pt: Comitê parlamentar revisará opções de trabalho flexível em meio ao aumento dos preços dos combustíveis
title_fr: Un comité parlementaire examinera les options de travail flexible face à la hausse des prix du carburant
summary_es: El comité parlamentario de Jamaica revisará opciones de trabajo flexible para abordar el aumento de los precios del combustible y la incertidumbre económica global. La iniciativa busca mejorar la productividad, reducir costos y mejorar el equilibrio entre la vida laboral y personal.
summary_pt: O comitê parlamentar da Jamaica revisará opções de trabalho flexível para lidar com o aumento dos preços dos combustíveis e a incerteza econômica global. A iniciativa visa aumentar a produtividade, reduzir custos e melhorar o equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal.
summary_fr: Le comité parlementaire jamaïcain examinera les options de travail flexible pour faire face à la hausse des prix du carburant et à l'incertitude économique mondiale. L'initiative vise à améliorer la productivité, réduire les coûts et améliorer l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée.
title: Parliamentary committee to review flexible work options amid rising fuel prices

narrative_analysis: Young Jamaicans are cast as victims of institutional failure, but the PNPYO positions them as actively resisting corruption and demanding accountability for gun violence.
cui_bono: Illegal gun traffickers and corrupt officials benefit most.
summary: The PNP Youth Organisation backs calls for the FLA CEO's resignation after an Integrity Commission report reveals manipulated databases, missing ammunition, and server failures. Young Jamaicans are portrayed as bearing the deadly cost of this institutional corruption.
title_en: PNPYO backs Opposition’s call for immediate resignation of FLA CEO
title_es: PNPYO respalda el llamado de la Oposición a la renuncia inmediata del director ejecutivo de la FLA
title_pt: PNPYO apoia o pedido da Oposição para a renúncia imediata do CEO da FLA
title_fr: Le PNPYO soutient l'appel de l'Opposition à la démission immédiate du PDG de la FLA
summary_es: La Juventud del PNP respalda los pedidos de renuncia del director ejecutivo de la FLA tras un informe de la Comisión de Integridad que revela bases de datos manipuladas, municiones perdidas y fallas en servidores. Los jóvenes jamaicanos son presentados como quienes pagan el costo mortal de esta corrupción institucional.
summary_pt: A Juventude do PNP apoia os pedidos de renúncia do CEO da FLA após um relatório da Comissão de Integridade revelar bancos de dados manipulados, munições perdidas e falhas no servidor. Os jovens jamaicanos são retratados como os que pagam o custo mortal dessa corrupção institucional.
summary_fr: La jeunesse du PNP soutient les appels à la démission du PDG de la FLA après qu'un rapport de la Commission d'intégrité a révélé des bases de données manipulées, des munitions perdues et des défaillances de serveurs. Les jeunes Jamaïcains sont présentés comme ceux qui paient le prix mortel de cette corruption institutionnelle.
title: PNPYO backs Opposition’s call for immediate resignation of FLA CEO

narrative_analysis: Public sector workers are portrayed as absorbing unsustainable costs while waiting indefinitely, suggesting their labor is devalued by systemic neglect.
cui_bono: The Jamaican Ministry of Finance and the Public Service.
summary: The Jamaica Civil Service Association demands urgent resolution on travel allowance claims and wage negotiations, citing rising costs and dilapidated roads. Workers feel forced to subsidize government services from personal funds, fueling frustration.
title_en: JCSA demands urgent resolution on travelling allowance claims and outstanding wage negotiations
title_es: JCSA exige una resolución urgente sobre las reclamaciones de asignaciones de viaje y las negociaciones salariales pendientes
title_pt: JCSA exige resolução urgente sobre pedidos de auxílio-transporte e negociações salariais pendentes
title_fr: La JCSA exige une résolution urgente des demandes d'indemnités de déplacement et des négociations salariales en suspens
summary_es: La Asociación del Servicio Civil de Jamaica exige una resolución urgente sobre las reclamaciones de viáticos y las negociaciones salariales, citando el aumento de costos y el deterioro de las carreteras. Los trabajadores se sienten obligados a subsidiar los servicios gubernamentales con fondos personales.
summary_pt: A Associação do Serviço Civil da Jamaica exige resolução urgente sobre pedidos de auxílio-transporte e negociações salariais, citando custos crescentes e estradas deterioradas. Os trabalhadores sentem-se obrigados a subsidiar serviços governamentais com recursos próprios.
summary_fr: L'Association de la fonction publique jamaïcaine exige une résolution urgente des demandes d'indemnités de déplacement et des négociations salariales, invoquant la hausse des coûts et la détérioration des routes. Les travailleurs se sentent contraints de subventionner les services gouvernementaux avec leurs fonds personnels.
title: JCSA demands urgent resolution on travelling allowance claims and outstanding wage negotiations

narrative_analysis: Jamaicans appear as capable professionals deserving of fair consideration for a national leadership role, yet the framing subtly stresses a colonial pattern of importing foreign expertise.
cui_bono: The Jamaica Football Federation (JFF) benefits from maintaining institutional control.
summary: The Jamaica Football Federation has opened applications for the head coach position of the Reggae Boyz after a failed World Cup qualifying campaign. Interim coach Rudolph Speid is being considered for the permanent role alongside assistant Miguel Coley, highlighting internal talent amid the search.
title_en: Applications open for Reggae Boyz head coach position — JFF
title_es: Abiertas las solicitudes para el puesto de entrenador de los Reggae Boyz — JFF
title_pt: Inscrições abertas para o cargo de técnico dos Reggae Boyz — JFF
title_fr: Candidatures ouvertes pour le poste d'entraîneur des Reggae Boyz — JFF
summary_es: La Federación de Fútbol de Jamaica ha abierto las solicitudes para el puesto de entrenador de los Reggae Boyz tras una campaña fallida de clasificación mundialista. El técnico interino Rudolph Speid es considerado para el cargo permanente.
summary_pt: A Federação de Futebol da Jamaica abriu inscrições para o cargo de técnico dos Reggae Boyz após uma campanha de classificação fracassada. O técnico interino Rudolph Speid é considerado para o cargo permanente.
summary_fr: La Fédération jamaïcaine de football a ouvert les candidatures pour le poste d'entraîneur des Reggae Boyz après une campagne de qualification infructueuse. L'entraîneur par intérim Rudolph Speid est considéré pour le poste permanent.
title: Applications open for Reggae Boyz head coach position — JFF

narrative_analysis: Black men appear as nameless casualties in a terse police report, stripped of context, reducing violent death to a routine statistic.
cui_bono: Unclear.
summary: Police identified Delon Covell Asgill as the man killed in a shooting at Chapman Lane, Barbados. Three other men were injured. The brief report offers no social or economic context.
title_en: Chapman Lane shooting victim identified
title_es: Identificada víctima del tiroteo en Chapman Lane
title_pt: Vítima do tiroteio na Chapman Lane identificada
title_fr: La victime de la fusillade de Chapman Lane identifiée
summary_es: La policía identificó a Delon Covell Asgill como el hombre asesinado en un tiroteo en Chapman Lane, Barbados. Otros tres hombres resultaron heridos. El breve informe no ofrece contexto social ni económico.
summary_pt: A polícia identificou Delon Covell Asgill como o homem morto em um tiroteio na Chapman Lane, Barbados. Outros três homens ficaram feridos. A breve reportagem não oferece contexto social ou econômico.
summary_fr: La police a identifié Delon Covell Asgill comme l'homme tué lors d'une fusillade à Chapman Lane, à la Barbade. Trois autres hommes ont été blessés. Le bref rapport n'offre aucun contexte social ou économique.
title: Chapman Lane shooting victim identified

narrative_analysis: Roger Elliot Moore Jr. is portrayed as a talented, faith-driven young man whose global impact through storytelling humanizes Black creativity and resilience.
cui_bono: Social media platforms benefiting from his content's engagement.
summary: Roger Elliot Moore Jr., known as Metronade, a 23-year-old Barbadian-American filmmaker and content creator, died in an accident. He built a massive online following through relatable and faith-based storytelling.
title_en: Young creative dies in accident
title_es: Joven creativo muere en accidente
title_pt: Jovem criativo morre em acidente
title_fr: Jeune créatif meurt dans un accident
summary_es: Roger Elliot Moore Jr., conocido como Metronade, un cineasta y creador de contenido barbadense-estadounidense de 23 años, falleció en un accidente. Construyó una enorme comunidad en línea a través de narraciones cercanas y basadas en su fe.
summary_pt: Roger Elliot Moore Jr., conhecido como Metronade, um cineasta e criador de conteúdo barbadense-americano de 23 anos, morreu em um acidente. Ele construiu uma enorme comunidade online através de narrativas relacionáveis e baseadas na fé.
summary_fr: Roger Elliot Moore Jr., connu sous le nom de Metronade, un cinéaste et créateur de contenu barbadien-américain de 23 ans, est décédé dans un accident. Il a bâti une immense communauté en ligne grâce à des récits accessibles et inspirés par sa foi.
title: Young creative dies in accident

narrative_analysis: The story presents a Black sports administrator making a thoughtful career shift, highlighting individual agency and dedication to grassroots development without racialized framing.
cui_bono: Rush Soccer, the U.S.-based partner organization.
summary: Renaldo Gilkes steps down as first team coach of Kickstart Rush to focus on grassroots development and his role as technical director. The decision allows him to manage increased responsibilities with Rush Soccer in Colorado.
title_en: Gilkes steps down as Kickstart coach
title_es: Gilkes renuncia como entrenador de Kickstart
title_pt: Gilkes deixa o cargo de técnico do Kickstart
title_fr: Gilkes quitte son poste d'entraîneur du Kickstart
summary_es: Renaldo Gilkes deja el cargo de entrenador del primer equipo de Kickstart Rush para concentrarse en el desarrollo de base y en su rol como director técnico. La decisión le permite gestionar mayores responsabilidades con Rush Soccer en Colorado.
summary_pt: Renaldo Gilkes deixa o cargo de técnico do time principal do Kickstart Rush para focar no desenvolvimento de base e em seu papel como diretor técnico. A decisão permite gerenciar maiores responsabilidades com o Rush Soccer no Colorado.
summary_fr: Renaldo Gilkes quitte son poste d'entraîneur de l'équipe première de Kickstart Rush pour se concentrer sur le développement de base et son rôle de directeur technique. Cette décision lui permet de gérer des responsabilités accrues avec Rush Soccer au Colorado.
title: Gilkes steps down as Kickstart coach

narrative_analysis: Black communities are entirely absent from this story, which treats war policy as a purely internal political struggle among white elites.
cui_bono: Unclear.
summary: The US House passed a symbolic war powers resolution to curb Trump's military actions in Iran. Four Republicans joined Democrats in a rebuke, reflecting rising public opposition and party division.
title_en: US House delivers rebuke to Trump as it votes to halt Iran war
title_es: La Cámara de Representantes de EE.UU. reprende a Trump al votar para detener la guerra en Irán
title_pt: Câmara dos EUA dá repreensão a Trump ao votar para interromper guerra no Irã
title_fr: La Chambre des représentants des États-Unis réprimande Trump en votant pour arrêter la guerre en Iran

narrative_analysis: Readers meet Representative Wilson as a dedicated public servant and mentor, whose career is celebrated for youth advocacy and community empowerment, reflecting Black political agency.
cui_bono: Black youth and the Democratic Party benefit from her mentorship legacy.
summary: Longtime Democratic U.S. Rep. Frederica Wilson has announced her retirement after nearly 30 years in Florida politics, ending a career marked by education advocacy, youth mentorship, and civil rights activism. She plans to expand her 5,000 Role Models program nationally. Her departure closes a significant chapter for Miami-Dade's Black political leadership.
title_en: Florida Rep. Frederica Wilson to retire, ending nearly 30-year career in Florida politics
title_es: La representante de Florida Frederica Wilson se retira, poniendo fin a casi 30 años de carrera política en Florida
title_pt: A deputada da Flórida Frederica Wilson se aposenta, encerrando quase 30 anos de carreira política na Flórida

summary_es: La congresista demócrata Frederica Wilson anunció su retiro después de casi 30 años en la política de Florida, culminando una carrera centrada en la educación, la mentoría juvenil y los derechos civiles. Planea expandir su programa 5,000 Role Models a nivel nacional. Su partida cierra un capítulo importante para el liderazgo político negro de Miami-Dade.
summary_pt: A deputada democrata Frederica Wilson anunciou sua aposentadoria após quase 30 anos na política da Flórida, encerrando uma carreira marcada pela defesa da educação, mentoria juvenil e ativismo pelos direitos civis. Elle prévoit d'étendre son programme 5 000 Role Models à l'échelle nationale. Son départ clôt un chapitre important pour le leadership politique noir de Miami-Dade.

summary: A special report details how vaccine hesitancy in Sokoto, Nigeria, fuels the spread of circulating Vaccine-Derived Poliovirus, affecting children like Karima. The story highlights low routine immunization and community refusal but lacks analysis of historical distrust or economic constraints driving the hesitancy.
title_en: SPECIAL REPORT: Inside Sokoto’s fight against polio vaccine hesitancy

summary_pt: Um relatório detalha como a hesitação vacinal em Sokoto, Nigéria, impulsiona a propagação do poliovírus derivado da vacina, afetando crianças como Karima, sem analisar a desconfiança histórica ou limitações econômicas.
summary_fr: Un rapport détaille comment la réticence aux vaccins à Sokoto, au Nigéria, alimente la propagation du poliovirus dérivé du vaccin, affectant des enfants comme Karima, sans analyser la méfiance historique ou les contraintes économiques.

narrative_analysis: Black political actors are reduced to case studies of strategic failure, their choices and consequences framed without reference to systemic barriers or colonial legacies.

summary: The opinion piece discusses the historical and strategic implications of election boycotts by opposition parties in various African countries, using examples from Zimbabwe, Côte d'Ivoire, and others. It argues that boycotts often backfire, weakening opposition movements and strengthening incumbents, without addressing deeper structural inequalities.
title_en: Boycott the boycottables

title_pt: Boicote os boicotáveis

Sostiene que los boicots suelen resultar contraproducentes, debilitando a la oposición y fortaleciendo a los gobernantes, sin abordar las desigualdades estructurales subyacentes.
summary_pt: O artigo de opinião discute as implicações históricas e estratégicas dos boicotes eleitorais da oposição em vários países africanos, usando exemplos do Zimbábue, Costa do Marfim e outros. Argumenta que os boicotes muitas vezes saem pela culatra, enfraquecendo a oposição e fortalecendo os governantes, sem abordar as desigualdades estruturais subjacentes.

Il soutient que les boycotts se retournent souvent contre eux, affaiblissant l'opposition et renforçant les gouvernants, sans aborder les inégalités structurelles sous-jacentes.

narrative_analysis: The story presents Black Niger Delta communities as obstacles to corporate profit, their legal victories for compensation framed as a reason for oil companies leaving.
cui_bono: International oil companies avoiding onshore costs.
summary: The NDDC MD explains that international oil companies are leaving Nigeria's onshore operations due to high compensation payments from court judgments and heavy taxes, not just pipeline attacks. This divestment hurts local workers and operators, as seen when Oando acquired Agip and laid off Nigerian employees.
title_en: Why international oil companies are leaving Nigeria — NDDC MD
title_es: Por qué las compañías petroleras internacionales abandonan Nigeria — Director Gerente de la NDDC
title_pt: Por que as empresas petrolíferas internacionais estão deixando a Nigéria — Diretor-gerente da NDDC
title_fr: Pourquoi les compagnies pétrolières internationales quittent le Nigeria — Directeur général de la NDDC
summary_es: El director de la NDDC explica que las petroleras internacionales abandonan las operaciones en tierra en Nigeria debido a los altos pagos de compensación por sentencias judiciales y los fuertes impuestos, no solo por los ataques a oleoductos. Esta desinversión perjudica a los trabajadores y operadores locales, como cuando Oando adquirió Agip y despidió empleados nigerianos.
summary_pt: O diretor da NDDC explica que as petrolíferas internacionais estão deixando as operações onshore na Nigéria devido aos altos pagamentos de indenizações judiciais e pesados impostos, não apenas aos ataques a oleodutos. Este desinvestimento prejudica trabalhadores e operadores locais, como quando a Oando comprou a Agip e demitiu funcionários nigerianos.
summary_fr: Le directeur de la NDDC explique que les compagnies pétrolières internationales quittent les opérations terrestres au Nigeria en raison des lourdes indemnités judiciaires et des taxes élevées, pas seulement des attaques sur les pipelines. Ce désinvestissement nuit aux travailleurs et opérateurs locaux, comme lorsque Oando a racheté Agip et licencié des employés nigérians.
title: Why international oil companies are leaving Nigeria — NDDC MD

narrative_analysis: Corps members appear as vulnerable young graduates left exposed to exploitation by private firms and crime due to government agencies' rejection.
cui_bono: Private firms benefit from cheap labor when corps members are rejected.
summary: Nigeria's House of Representatives has directed government agencies to stop rejecting National Youth Service Corps members, warning that the practice undermines national unity and exposes graduates to exploitation. The motion highlighted that rejections waste public resources and deprive young Nigerians of essential work experience.
title_en: Stop rejecting corps members, Reps tell govt agencies
title_es: Dejen de rechazar a los miembros del cuerpo, dicen los representantes a las agencias gubernamentales
title_pt: Parem de rejeitar membros do corpo, dizem deputados a agências governamentais
title_fr: Arrêtez de rejeter les membres du corps, disent les députés aux agences gouvernementales
summary_es: La Cámara de Representantes de Nigeria ordenó a las agencias gubernamentales que dejen de rechazar a los miembros del Cuerpo Nacional de Servicio Juvenil, advirtiendo que la práctica socava la unidad nacional y expone a los graduados a la explotación. La moción destacó que los rechazos desperdician recursos públicos y privan a los jóvenes nigerianos de experiencia laboral esencial.
summary_pt: A Câmara dos Representantes da Nigéria ordenou que agências governamentais parem de rejeitar membros do Corpo Nacional de Serviço Juvenil, alertando que a prática prejudica a unidade nacional e expõe graduados à exploração. A moção destacou que as rejeições desperdiçam recursos públicos e privam jovens nigerianos de experiência profissional essencial.
summary_fr: La Chambre des représentants du Nigeria a ordonné aux agences gouvernementales de cesser de rejeter les membres du Corps national du service de la jeunesse, avertissant que cette pratique sape l'unité nationale et expose les diplômés à l'exploitation. La motion a souligné que les rejets gaspillent les ressources publiques et privent les jeunes Nigérians d'une expérience professionnelle essentielle.
title: Stop rejecting corps members, Reps tell govt agencies

summary_pt: O artigo examina como a guerra às drogas devastou as comunidades negras e latinas em Nova York por meio do encarceramento em massa, perda de empregos e desintegração familiar, enquanto bloqueia seu acesso ao cannabis medicinal.

summary_pt: Este relatório do Bureau of Justice Statistics detalha as taxas de encarceramento por raça e gênero em prisões e cadeias dos EUA até 2023. Adultos negros são encarcerados a uma taxa de 1.218 por 100.000, cinco vezes a taxa de brancos, com um ligeiro aumento desde 2022.

cui_bono: The prison-industrial complex and private prison corporations benefit most.
summary: A new report by The Sentencing Project reveals that New Jersey has the worst racial disparity in prison incarceration in the U.S., with Black residents imprisoned at 12.5 times the rate of whites. narrative_analysis: Readers meet a Black man through his personal achievements and family ties, humanizing him against a backdrop of systemic sentencing inequality.
cui_bono: The prison-industrial complex benefits from lengthy drug sentences.

It advocates for the Equal Act to eliminate the sentencing disparity between crack and powder cocaine, which disproportionately harms Black communities.

title_pt: Uma Disparidade Racista: A Lei Equal e a Redenção de um Homem

Aboga por la Ley Equal para eliminar la disparidad de sentencias entre crack y cocaína en polvo, que perjudica desproporcionadamente a comunidades negras.

summary: Nigeria's 2025 capital inflows surged to $23.22bn, but foreign direct investment made up less than 4% as portfolio investments dominated. This imbalance highlights the country's reliance on short-term capital over sustainable, job-creating investment.
title_en: FDI in Nigeria Underperforms Amid 2025 Capital Inflow Surge
title_es: La IED en Nigeria no rinde bien en medio del aumento de entradas de capital en 2025

summary_pt: As entradas de capital da Nigéria em 2025 subiram para US$ 23,22 bilhões, mas o investimento estrangeiro direto representou menos de 4%, dominado por investimentos em carteira. Esse desequilíbrio destaca a dependência do país em capital de curto prazo.
summary_fr: Les entrées de capitaux du Nigeria en 2025 ont bondi à 23,22 milliards de dollars, mais les investissements directs étrangers ne représentaient que 4%, dominés par les investissements de portefeuille. Ce déséquilibre souligne la dépendance du pays aux capitaux à court terme.
title: FDI in Nigeria Underperforms Amid 2025 Capital Inflow Surge

narrative_analysis: Land ownership statistics are used to highlight the enduring structural dispossession of Black South Africans, framing them as victims of colonial and apartheid land theft.
cui_bono: White commercial farming interests and the US political right.
summary: The article explains South Africa's Expropriation Act, which allows land seizure without compensation, and the controversy sparked by Trump's executive order halting aid and offering refugee status to white farmers. It details how apartheid and colonial laws left 72% of agricultural land in white hands and only 4% with Black South Africans, positioning the law as a corrective measure.

Detalla cómo el apartheid y las leyes coloniales dejaron el 72% de la tierra agrícola en manos blancas y solo el 4% en manos de sudafricanos negros, presentando la ley como una medida correctiva.
summary_pt: O artigo explica a Lei de Expropriação da África do Sul, que permite a tomada de terras sem compensação, e a controvérsia gerada pela ordem executiva de Trump suspendendo a ajuda e oferecendo status de refugiado a agricultores brancos. Detalha como o apartheid e as leis coloniais deixaram 72% das terras agrícolas nas mãos de brancos e apenas 4% com sul-africanos negros, posicionando a lei como uma medida corretiva.
summary_fr: L'article explique la loi sud-africaine sur l'expropriation, qui permet la saisie de terres sans compensation, et la controverse suscitée par le décret de Trump suspendant l'aide et offrant le statut de réfugié aux agriculteurs blancs. Il détaille comment l'apartheid et les lois coloniales ont laissé 72% des terres agricoles aux mains des Blancs et seulement 4% aux Sud-Africains noirs, présentant la loi comme une mesure corrective.
title: Explainer: Understanding the South Africa Land-Reform Law that Provoked Trump’s Ire - JURIST - Features - Legal News & Commentary

narrative_analysis: The people of Papua New Guinea are portrayed as victims of corporate land theft, their agency undermined by corruption and colonial-era exploitation.
cui_bono: Malaysian logging company Rimbunan Hijau.
summary: Foreign logging corporations in Papua New Guinea are using fraudulent leases and police collusion to seize indigenous land, despite most land being under customary title. The scheme bypasses environmental laws, destroying forests that 80 percent of Papuans depend on. Communities resisting the land grab face violent suppression from police paid by the logging companies.
title_en: Logs don’t lie: foreign corporations are pillaging Papua New Guinea

El esquema evade las leyes ambientales, destruyendo bosques de los que depende el 80 por ciento de los papúes. Las comunidades que resisten enfrentan represión violenta de la policía pagada por las empresas.
summary_pt: Corporações madeireiras estrangeiras em Papua-Nova Guiné usam arrendamentos fraudulentos e conluio policial para tomar terras indígenas, apesar de a maioria ser sob título consuetudinário. O esquema burla leis ambientais, destruindo florestas das quais 80% dos papuas dependem. Comunidades que resistem enfrentam repressão violenta da polícia paga pelas empresas.
summary_fr: Des entreprises forestières étrangères en Papouasie-Nouvelle-Guinée utilisent des baux frauduleux et la collusion policière pour s'emparer de terres autochtones, bien que la majorité des terres soient sous régime coutumier. Ce système contourne les lois environnementales, détruisant les forêts dont dépendent 80 % des Papous. Les communautés qui résistent subissent une répression violente de la police payée par les entreprises.
title: Logs don't lie: foreign corporations are pillaging Papua New Guinea

summary_es: El artículo analiza la primera base militar china en Yibuti, presentando a África como un campo de batalla en la rivalidad entre EE.UU. y China. Destaca la creciente influencia económica china y los desafíos de EE.UU., pero omite las perspectivas africanas.
